Who I am

About me

I am a final-year engineering student at the University of Wollongong in Dubai, with hands-on experience in autonomous robotics, machine learning and IoT.

Embedded systems are what excite me most. I love the moment code meets hardware, when a sensor reading turns into a decision on a real device, and I would love to build my career working on exactly that, from IoT nodes and robots to satellite subsystems.

I work well in teams and enjoy leading them. I served on the Engineers Australia UAE Chapter board, running hands-on workshops and mentoring students, helped build university partnerships for AIESEC, and led frontend development as a technical lead at ASPIR. I like sharing what I learn and building alongside people who push each other forward.
